note: T10 layout grammar. Author only what cannot be derived. Counters are pack-constant; coordinates are a function of seed. Nothing here is a tick input.

road_period_tiles.why: Longest footprint is four tiles; gap one; two lots on a side need seven interior tiles. Period eight. Period seven leaves courtyard_side equal to lot_ring_depth so the yard does not read as a park; period nine makes the yard wider than the ring and the city reads loose

building_gap_tiles.why: Minimum gap between neighbouring lots. Zero merges footprints; two wastes a tile on a seven-tile side and drops a lot

lot_min_side_tiles.why: Smallest lot side. One-tile fillers and billboards exist; zero is not a rectangle

blocks_reserve.why: Diamond of L1 radius zone_anchor_ring_step already exceeds ceil(lots/lots_per_block). Extra reserve would push R without adding a zone

water_margin_tiles.why: Water ring around the island. One tile lets a block touch the map edge; three is a second unused sea

shore_jitter_tiles.why: Shore roughness amplitude. Zero is a perfect circle; two starts to nibble the outer ring that L191 forbids touching

mini_island_share_bps.why: Share of water tiles that become mini-islands. Half a percent of a large sea is clutter; this is four per thousand, spaced two tiles from shore

zone_anchor_ring_step.why: L1 ring radius for six district anchors. Ring two cannot cut six orthogonally connected equal wedges: diagonal cells only touch ring one. Ring three gives four blocks per district and a connected diamond

filler_slots_per_kind.why: Lot budget per district-coloured filler kind. One looks empty after the beacon; three forces extra blocks past the diamond of zone_anchor_ring_step

district_fill_step_bps.why: Occupied share of free lots per district tier. Three tiers reach 7500 bps, under the 10000 cap, so a maxed district still shows empty lots

decor_target_share_bps.why: Decor budget, not a driver. Lanterns plus trees should land near twelve percent of land; the generator does not paint over lots to hit it

decor_share_tolerance_bps.why: Plus or minus four hundred bps around the decor budget. Tighter than the band would fail honest packing; wider would hide a generator that paved lots

vehicles_per_100_road_tiles.why: Background cars per hundred road tiles. Count is pack-constant; tiles come from the seed. They never occupy a lot

drones_per_100_blocks.why: Background drones per hundred blocks. One per four blocks is visible without crowding roofs

walkers_per_100_sidewalk_tiles.why: Background pedestrians per hundred sidewalk tiles. High enough that every walker and robot skin appears at least once; they occupy no lot, bind no agent_id, and are not a click target

tree_cap_share_bps.why: Courtyard groves only, no allee. Fifty-four bps is fourteen trees on this land so the count stays pack-constant across seeds (L175); leftover decor budget is street furniture

camera_edge_margin_tiles.why: Pan limit beyond the island bbox. Zero clips the shore; four is a second unused sea in camera space

zoom_max_scale.why: Largest integer pixel scale. Triple magnification shows no new silhouette and triples texture memory

demo_seed.why: Canonical seed for the demo city and the art preview. Any other seed must keep the counter vector identical

sidewalk_furniture_step_tiles.why: Cadence of bins, benches and booths along sidewalk facing a road. Two keeps a bench rhythm; four left the curb empty after R-V-58

allee_step_tiles.why: Allee planting is off (R-V-58); the step stays in the pack so the key is not a major. Generator does not read it

tree_corner_gap_tiles.why: Zero: the grove fills the park courtyard. A gap of one left the yard as empty grass

tint_alpha_bps.why: Dawn wash from the amber ramp. Hours are derived from time.json; only the tint is authored

sun_azimuth_bps.why: Dawn sun yaw as a share of a full turn (east). Packed so render src does not invent an hour or a compass

sun_elevation_bps.why: Dawn sun elevation as a share of a right angle from the horizon. Low, not zenith; day must sit higher

sun_intensity_bps.why: Dawn directional intensity in bps of opaque. Below day so the city ramps up; above night so dawn is not moon fill

ambient_bps.why: Dawn fill so north faces are not black. Packed so AmbientLight is not a TypeScript default

dawn.why: Dawn uses the energy/warn ramp so the 06:00 efficiency recalc is readable on the scene

tint_alpha_bps.why: Day has no wash. Lights off. Zero alpha is a tint token that HUD already names

sun_azimuth_bps.why: Day sun yaw as a share of a full turn. Not a copy of orbit_azimuth_bps; packed so noon is not a literal hour

sun_elevation_bps.why: Day sun elevation as a share of a right angle from the horizon. Highest of the four phases; night must sit lower

sun_intensity_bps.why: Day directional intensity. The city stays on because the sun lights Lambert materials, not because windows stay neon

ambient_bps.why: Day fill. Highest ambient of the four so shaded walls stay readable without baked sun on albedo

day.why: Day is the untoned scene; lanterns and window lights are off

tint_alpha_bps.why: Dusk wash from the bad/energy ramp as the bank closes

sun_azimuth_bps.why: Dusk sun yaw as a share of a full turn (west). Opposite dawn; packed so render src does not invent 20:00

sun_elevation_bps.why: Dusk sun elevation as a share of a right angle from the horizon. Low and distinct from dawn so the two shoulders are not one pose

sun_intensity_bps.why: Dusk directional intensity. Below dawn so the close of the bank reads as a fall, not a second sunrise

ambient_bps.why: Dusk fill. Below dawn so neon windows start to read as the sun drops

dusk.why: Dusk starts at bank_close_hour; crimson is already the HUD energy token

tint_alpha_bps.why: Night wash from the panel navy ramp. Stronger than dusk so window lights read

sun_azimuth_bps.why: Night moon yaw as a share of a full turn. Not a copy of day azimuth; packed so the fill has a direction without a baked night gradient

sun_elevation_bps.why: Night moon elevation as a share of a right angle from the horizon. Lowest of the four; day must sit higher so L376 can fail an inverted rig

sun_intensity_bps.why: Night directional fill. Far below day so neon windows are the native phase, not a second sun on albedo

ambient_bps.why: Night fill. Lowest ambient of the four so unlit walls stay dark without painting night onto the mesh

night.why: Night is navy, the same ramp as HUD panels, so scene and chrome stay one piece

derived.lot_ring_depth: max min(w,h) over building footprints, at least lot_min_side_tiles
derived.island_radius_tiles: smallest R such that full land blocks ≥ blocks_required
derived.lots_per_block: packed N/S widths times 2 plus packed E/W heights times 2
derived.lots_needed: six base lots plus per district (beacon + home synergies + filler_slots_per_kind × kinds + billboard)
derived.blocks_on_land: count of blocks whose interior and bounding roads lie on the unjittered land disk
derived.road_origin_x: cx − road_period_tiles // 2 so City Hall sits in the centre block
derived.min_road_period: smallest P with courtyard ≥ 1 and a side holding the longest footprint plus gap plus min lot, plus road_span_tiles
derived.zone_rotation: draw_below(district_count) on stream zone_rotation; rotates labels only, never wedge geometry
derived.phase_hours_sum: sum of phase durations; must equal 24
derived.phases: boundaries from time.json, tint from placement.phases
derived.zoom_min_scale_num: numerator of min zoom; always 1 because levels are 1/2^k
derived.zoom_min_scale_den: smallest 2^k such that the iso bbox fits the HUD-derived safe rect
derived.zoom_levels: powers of two from zoom_min through zoom_max_scale
derived.safe_rect_w_px: aspect_w × tile_w − 2 × column_width_px from the HUD fixture
derived.safe_rect_h_px: viewport_h − topbar − stock_strip − bottom_menu from the HUD fixture
derived.zone_centroids: mean of block centres per zone, not stored as author data
derived.level_overlays: per-level pip, window and antenna counts; sprite_id does not change
derived.scene_badges: IDLE_* mapped by prefix to shortage/occupancy/idle; state_source from screens.json
derived.log_only_idle: IDLE_* whose state_surfaces do not include scene
derived.park_slots: economic_bridge: 1 + open districts from playable_v1, not from the plan
derived.plaza_slots: economic_bridge: one plaza per open district
derived.filler_occupied_total: economic_bridge: sum over zones of free_lots × fill_share(tier) / 10000
derived.decor_realized_share_bps: decor tiles × 10000 / land_tiles on the unjittered disk
derived.lantern_count: chessboard intersections of the road grid; no hand coordinates
derived.tree_count: min(tree_cap_share_bps of land, remaining decor budget after lanterns/vehicles/drones); leftover budget is street furniture
derived.road_tiles: land tiles matching the road predicate
derived.lots_per_zone: lot counts by zone; invariant across seeds
derived.lots_by_kind: lot counts by footprint and side
derived.economic_bridges: park_slots, plaza_slots, filler_occupied_total from district state
derived.tick_inputs: empty list: layout is not an economic input
derived.layout_hash: sha256 of the canonical scene artifact
derived.prng_streams: named streams under city_id:layout:stream:index including walker, street, robot
derived.lots: lot records: block, index, x, y, w, h, side, road_tile, zone, accepts
derived.reference_layout: demo placement of base, beacons, synergies, filler
derived.trees: park courtyard groves only; cap from tree_cap_share_bps, leftover budget is street furniture, not allee (R-V-58)
derived.street: benches and phone booths on sidewalk and plaza cadence; not on grass or industrial yards
derived.walkers: background pedestrians on sidewalk tiles only; no agent_id, no lot, no click
derived.shore: land tiles orthogonally adjacent to water
derived.jittered_tiles: shore-band flips; must not include protected block or road tiles
derived.protected_tiles: count of tiles jitter must not flip
derived.zone_block_counts: blocks per zone, quota not seed
